summary: Iteration 6 — Frontend-only regression of the new photo mapping (SFL Champions trophy-lift + Ladies at National Stadium + HK men's team + kit flat-lay) on both the web deck and the PPTX export. All 8 review-request checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: generatePptx.js still contains a duplicate embedded image: heroImages.cover === heroImages.champions (same URL), so ppt/media/ actually has 6 image entries but two of them (image-1-1 and image-4-1) are byte-identical duplicates of the SFL trophy-lift photo. Not a bug — the deck spec allows this — but a minor size optimisation would be to reuse the same fetched dataURL for both slides instead of re-adding it.
generatePptx.js file is 1150+ lines. Consider splitting per-slide builders into /src/lib/pptx/ modules for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).

OpeningSections.jsx Heritage caption 'At the National Stadium' is rendered with CSS uppercase — this is intentional but means text search / accessibility tools see the CSS-transformed text; consider adding aria-label if screen-reader intent matters.
